revision_summary: One quote timestamp needs correction and one internal labeling contradiction needs fixing; otherwise the analysis is well-grounded. Fixes required on rerun: (1) In multi_touch_patterns[1].touches[0], the quote 'I've had a couple of the companies...' is timestamped 10:56 but actually occurs at approximately 11:25-11:39; correct the ts. (2) Relabel the classification field for the two moments at 09:14 and 10:10 (currently both tagged 'setter_scope_creep') -- these are explicitly described in stewart_read/coaching_implication as the rep correctly HOLDING scope, so the classification label is self-contradictory and should read something like 'scope_discipline_held' to avoid a manager misreading these as negative flags. (3) Tighten schema_reference citations: rebuttals.already_saw_design is a rebuttal template, not the right anchor for the 'prior_contact_probe_miss' competitive-intel coaching points -- reference verify.prior_designs or a general competitive-intel directive instead. (4) Surface the rep's weak bill-flip attempt at 04:36-04:44 ('that's definitely pretty hefty bill... solar definitely makes sense... with everything going on in the world') in bill_anchor_audit rather than a flat flip_executed:'no' -- this was a diluted/generic flip attempt, not a total absence, and the coaching note should reflect 'attempted but not anchored to the specific $280 number' rather than omission. (5) Consider adding the 13:01 unfavorable competitor comparison ('you guys aren't even very close to two of them yet... a satellite that you can zoom in on...') as its own flagged moment given its directness as a closer-facing risk signal, rather than folding it only into the generic competitive-disclosure pattern.
